name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_battle_ prefix (battle core table), 'summon_anim_variant_a_6slot' is meaningful domain semantics (variant A, 6 animation slots -- not address residue), and 'jitter_byte_array' reflects both the data type (uint8 array) and the semantics (per-slot vertical jitter). No Ghidra address residue in the name. Matches globals.h declaration, the reimplemented user in src/anim/anisummn.c, and the tests.
purpose: Per-slot vertical jitter byte (0 or 7) for the variant-A 6-slot summon-spell animation; added to the sprite frame index when blitting each slot's frame.
logic_summary: uint8[6], one entry per animation slot. Written by fd2_tick_summon_anim_variant_a_6slot (0x269D3): the INIT state (state_code==0, write at 0x26A71) and the per-slot frame-8 color-rotation/wrap path (write at 0x26BE4) both store (rng%2 << 3) - (rng%2) = (rng%2)*7, i.e. 0 or 7. Read in TICK frames (state_code 2/5/8, read at 0x26B1F) via MOVZX (zero-extended, unsigned) and added to the frame index passed to fd2_blit_indexed_sprite. Stride 1 (byte MOVs). First access on every animation is a write (INIT) before any read.
element_semantics: Per-slot vertical jitter offset byte; value is 0 or 7 (= (rng%2)*7). Read zero-extended (unsigned) and added to the per-slot sprite frame index. Index 0..5 = animation slot id.
